name: DevOps Engineer - Cloud
jd_text:
DevOps Engineer — CloudNine Infrastructure

About Us:
CloudNine provides managed cloud infrastructure for enterprise clients.

Requirements:
- Proficiency in Linux system administration
- Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes
- Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or Ansible
- CI/CD pipeline design and implementation (Jenkins/GitHub Actions)
- Cloud platform expertise (AWS required: EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS)
- Monitoring and logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack)
- Scripting skills (Bash, Python)

Nice to Have:
- Experience with service mesh (Istio)
- Knowledge of security best practices (IAM, secrets management)
- Experience with multi-cloud deployments
- Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect, CKA

Responsibilities:
- Design and maintain cloud infrastructure
- Automate deployment pipelines
- Monitor system health and respond to incidents
- Implement security best practices
